personas.name: F-E Developer
personas.reaction: Pure rules stepped frame by frame and a test per rule: fine. But the fall touches the kart, the rivals, the race, the texture and the sound at once, so I want each piece proven on its own.

personas.name: B-E DEv
personas.reaction: The rivals cut corners across the verge on purpose today. Turn that verge into a hole and they fall in every tight corner, and nothing here proves they will not.

personas.name: Paul - Product Manager
personas.reaction: A player's idea in one line, turned into a game rule that makes the circuit feel like space: that is exactly the kind of delight I want shipped.

personas.name: Lead Engineer
personas.reaction: The fall sits beside the spin-out on the same model, and the pace is rebuilt instead of guessed from the jump: the race keeps one rule for laps.

personas.name: Irisa
personas.reaction: Feedback from someone who played, made into a PRD the same day: a quick win players will notice.

objection.text: The rivals cut corners across the verge today, on purpose (cornerGate). With the void there, they will fall in every tight corner, and nothing in this design proves otherwise.

personas.name: F-E Developer
personas.reaction: Each rule has its own seam: the fall in kart.test, the way back in rivals.test, the void's colours in texture.test. And the wall code goes instead of staying dead.

personas.name: B-E DEv
personas.reaction: A whole race of COMET RING in a test, one fall per rival at most, and the corner cut tightened only if it fails: that answers my objection with a number.

personas.name: Paul - Product Manager
personas.reaction: Fifteen criteria anyone can watch in a race, and no reset of the players' best times: ready to build.

personas.name: Lead Engineer
personas.reaction: No stored shape moves, the rollback is a revert, and the pace is never fed the jump: a small, safe change for what it brings.

personas.name: Irisa
personas.reaction: Scope held tight: the horizon stays its own PRD, and the items keep their rules.

personas.name: F-E Developer
personas.reaction: Each piece landed with its own tests: the void in track and texture, the fall in kart, the rivals in their own race. The one guard lost with the sparks, no particle when motion is reduced, came back on the box's flash and turns red when broken.

personas.name: B-E DEv
personas.reaction: My objection is answered in code: a whole race of COMET RING, on three seeds, ends with every rival falling at most once. I still want to see one race myself before I call it more than a toy.

personas.name: Paul - Product Manager
personas.reaction: A player's one-line idea is a circuit in space in a single day, and the release note says it in three plain sentences anyone can read.

personas.name: Lead Engineer
personas.reaction: No stored shape moved, a map with the old verge or wall is now refused outright, and the rollback is a revert. The fall sits beside the spin-out as the design said.

personas.name: Irisa
personas.reaction: Customer feedback in, a visible change out, and nothing else in the game moved: the horizon stays its own PRD, as agreed.
